instruction: The software choices can be launched from: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. For the steps below, open Revit 2025, Archicad 27, or Abaqus CAE from the corresponding desktop shortcut, according to the tool you choose for the task. Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool from these three to complete the task. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the selected application before editing. The seed IFC is intentionally prepared with stable base geometry so the task can be completed with reliable native edits in the selected application: keep the existing floor slab and other useful seed elements unless the task explicitly asks you to add or rename something. If the imported IFC space is not available as a native room/zone/space, place a new room/zone/space in the bounded area and use a room/space schedule or room properties to set the required room name. Seed split into lobby and office. The seed already contains the exterior shell, one floor slab, one partition wall, one exterior door, one interior door, and windows. The partition and hosted door/window elements are preconfigured because hosted placement on imported IFC geometry is not reliable in this environment. Do not redraw the floor slab, partition, doors, or windows. Rename or recreate the two rooms as Lobby and Office using room properties or a room/space schedule. Create real BIM model elements rather than visual-only detail geometry. Use the selected application's Room/Zone/Space tool or editable imported room/space data for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result` using the selected application's built-in export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Lobby and Office; at least 1 building storey, at least 5 wall elements, at least 1 slab, at least 2 doors, at least 2 windows. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
